svg.title: FrogPilot Main Banner
svg.desc: FrogPilot main banner: the FrogPilot chauffeur frog driving a black Lexus ES 350 with a comma four under the rear-view mirror, on a straight country road through a wide valley of pines and meadows below snow-capped mountains. FrogPilot is driver-assistance software for cars.
